audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[0..5] read Zed and win[6] reads Fizz, matching the packet chart.
audit.why: Fizz is a melee laner who must walk to 550 for Urchin Strike and closer still to last-hit, against a 900-range Q on a flat 6s. Two items in, Playful / Trickster falls to an 8s untargetable hop that erases the mark outright.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Zed on rows 0-5 and Fizz on row 6, ratings adjusted, all seven whys rewritten to match. win[N] already agrees, so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never gives Playful / Trickster's cooldown, which is the entire spike curve of this matchup: 16s at rank 1 down to 8s at rank 5.
audit.why: At 16s you can bait it and still have a window; at 8s it is available for every commit you make.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field, phases[2].why and phases[6].why now carry the 16s and 8s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions from the missing-interactions file never reach the page: both Playful / Trickster and Chum the Waters carry grounding, which shuts off Zed's Living Shadow swap AND the Death Mark dash — the only two mobility tools he owns; and Seastone Trident is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.why: Kit flags: Fizz E and R both grounding; Zed W and R both dash. Seastone Trident carries autoReset on a 7/6/5/4/3 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into the cooldowns field, the trade lines and dosFull[1].d; the reset tell into dontsFull[2].d.

audit.why: Playful / Trickster 16/14/12/10/8, Urchin Strike 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Seastone Trident 7/6/5/4/3, Chum the Waters 120/100/80, Living Shadow 20/19/18/17/16.
